name: skillvault-discover
title: SkillVault Discover
description: [explain] Alone: past evaluations. Text: search or evaluate it. Discover skills for a purpose, evaluate a candidate against the catalog and earlier evaluations, and explain skills, tools, or products. Shorthand: /sv-discover. Evaluation saves a public-safe assessment unless chat only; search and explanation are read-only. None installs, runs, or edits the target.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Menu word: explain. Alone, the skill shows past evaluations and asks what to look for; other text searches for a purpose or evaluates a URL or skill. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Skill name, tool/product name, URL, capability, workflow, or problem: a purpose searches, a URL or skill name is evaluated, and after explain it names the subject. Omit it to see past evaluations.

examples: /skillvault-discover a skill that reviews SQL migrations
